question: Which track has the highest number of streams on Spotify?
sql:
SELECT T1.Name 
FROM Track AS T1 
JOIN (
    SELECT TrackId, COUNT(*) as stream_count 
    FROM Stream 
    GROUP BY TrackId 
    ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 1
) AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId

question: How many tickets were sold for the last AC/DC concert?
What rating do customers give the album 'Let There Be Rock'?
sql:
SELECT AVG(CASE 
             WHEN T2.Title = 'Let There Be Rock' THEN 5
             ELSE NULL
           END) AS AverageRating
FROM InvoiceLine AS TL
JOIN Invoice AS I ON TL.InvoiceId = I.InvoiceId
JOIN Track AS T ON TL.TrackId = T.TrackId
JOIN Album AS A ON T.AlbumId = A.AlbumId
JOIN Customer AS C ON I.CustomerId = C.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine AS TL2 ON T.TrackId = TL2.TrackId
JOIN Album AS A2 ON TL2.TrackId = A2.TrackId
JOIN Customer AS C2 ON TL2.InvoiceId = C2.InvoiceId
WHERE A2.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: Which customers cancelled their subscription last month?
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.*
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
WHERE DATE(i.InvoiceDate) BETWEEN DATE('now', '-1 month') AND DATE('now')
AND c.SupportRepId IS NULL

question: Which warehouse stores the most CDs?
sql:
SELECT w.Name 
FROM Warehouse w
JOIN Inventory i ON w.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId
JOIN Product p ON i.ProductId = p.ProductId
GROUP BY w.Name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
